gloss: rise and fall; ups and downs; floating and sinking

definitions.gloss: rise and fall; ups and downs; vicissitudes
definitions.explanation: the fluctuation between success and failure, prosperity and decline
the physical act of rising to the surface and sinking

notes:
{浮沈|ふちん} literally means "floating and sinking" and is most commonly used figuratively to describe the rise and fall of organizations, careers, or nations.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {浮沈|ふちん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかっている→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: the fate is at stake
- {浮沈|ふちん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{共|とも}にする→共にする：18718_tomonisuru⟧: to share the same fate
- {浮沈|ふちん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to go through repeated ups and downs

COMPOUNDS:
- {浮沈|ふちん}{子|し}: Cartesian diver (a science experiment demonstrating buoyancy)

- ⟦{栄枯|えいこ}→栄枯：08133_eiko⟧: prosperity and decline
- ⟦{盛衰|せいすい}→盛衰：05569_seisui⟧: rise and fall
- ⟦{興亡|こうぼう}→興亡：05568_koubou⟧: rise and fall (of nations)

REGISTER:
A formal, literary word. More common in written Japanese, news, and formal speech than in everyday conversation.
